verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rollbar's JavaScript SDK (rollbar.js) is published in a public GitHub repository, so some client-side source can be read. Nothing shows the core Rollbar service is open source, and no license is cited for the SDK repo. Missing for 10: evidence of an open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) on the SDK, public source for the core Rollbar platform/server, and documentation of the open-source scope across the other SDKs.
